yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.title: FPS Display Settings
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.showFpsTe: Show the 'FPS' text before the numerical value
Where the HUD sits on screen.
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.xOffset.d: Controls the X Offset from the left
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.yOffset.d: Controls the Y Offset from the top
A scrolling RTSS-style frametime bar graph shown below the FPS text.
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.enableFra: Shows a scrolling RTSS-style frametime bar graph below the FPS text
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.graphWidt: Width of the frametime graph in pixels
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.graphHeig: Height of the frametime graph in pixels
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.graphMaxM: Y-axis ceiling of the graph in milliseconds; bars reaching this height represent the worst frametimes
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.graphColo: Bar color for frames under the yellow threshold
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.yellowThr: Framerate threshold below which bars turn yellow (e.g., 60 FPS = 16.7 ms)
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.redThresh: Framerate threshold below which bars turn red (e.g., 30 FPS = 33.3 ms)
yacl3.config.fpsdisplay:config.yellowCol: Bar color for frames in the yellow range
Bar color for frames in the red range
The scale of the HUD elements, including the background
